description: This file provides helper functions for logging at various levels (info, debug, warn, error, success) using the zerolog library, implementing printf-style formatting.

methods.name: Infof
methods.description: Logs an info-level message with formatting.

methods.name: Debugf
methods.description: Logs a debug-level message with formatting.

methods.name: Warnf
methods.description: Logs a warning-level message with formatting.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Logs an error-level message with formatting.

methods.name: Successf
methods.description: Logs a success-level message (info with a checkmark).
